head: Microsoft 365 Family: 2TB shared instead of 1TB each
dek: Microsoft 365 Family and Premium now come with 2TB of OneDrive storage shared by up to six people, instead of 1TB for each person. The Family plan's price stays $13 a month.
details: New and upgraded subscriptions have the shared 2TB since 8 October. Existing plans switch when they renew on or after 2 May 2027; upgrading earlier, for example from Family to Premium, switches right away. Extra storage can be added, up to 10TB in total.
where: New plans since 8 October; existing plans at renewal from 2 May 2027
means: A family that uses more than 2TB together will run out of space after the switch, even though each person had 1TB before.
todo: Check how much OneDrive space your family uses together. Over 2TB? Plan a clean-up or extra storage before your first renewal after 2 May 2027, and keep in mind that upgrading to Premium switches you right away.
